title: Island Counter
description: Given a rectangular grid containing 1 for land and 0 for water, count the number of connected islands. Cells are connected only vertically and horizontally.
constraints: 1 <= rows, cols <= 500; every grid cell contains either 0 or 1.
inputFormat: First line: rows and cols. Next rows lines contain cols binary values without spaces.
hints: Whenever an unvisited land cell is found, start a traversal and mark the entire connected component.

examples.explanation: There are three separate groups of horizontally or vertically connected land cells.
